goal: Reduce real costs of fast and retained rendering for Fincode while preserving correctness and responsiveness
primary_target: At least 25% less requested dependency-record heap for 1024 records with empty entity/global/state dimensions
timing_gate: Paired median CPU/elapsed increases must fit baseline max-minus-min; primary improvement must be larger than both measured run ranges
memory_gate: At least 25% lower held/peak dependency heap in primary cases; nonempty controls allow at most 96 bytes of fixed lazy app-local pool overhead; no unbounded cache or lost dependencies
rss_gate: Median native peak RSS increase must fit baseline max-minus-min
limits: Linux System allocator component fixture, not Fincode mimalloc or GPU frame
No app-wide or macOS/Windows performance claim
fixed_overhead: Three Option<Rc<[T]>> handles occupy 48 bytes on 64-bit hosts; up to three empty Rc allocation headers request 48 bytes. App construction is outside the recorder census.
